Chapter 1 title 'A Desert Place' vs PG 'An open Place.' and paraphrased locations (2.2, 2.3, 3.3): VARIANT, not a defect (also noted in the staged package).
books.notes: Root cause: the Macbeth parser drops every blank-line-separated speech block that is not directly headed by a speaker line (continuations after inline stage directions, and verse/letter paragraph breaks). 34 blocks at 34 served locations, 1,300 words, grouped here into 13 findings; stage directions around them are served. All 28 non-heading alignment runs are accounted for. Local raw books/raw/macbeth/raw.txt equals current PG #1533 except a UTF-8 BOM; PG #100 Macbeth gives identical alignment. green-macbeth/PARKED.md records only the raven/Great Glamis and dagger passages; it attributes "Great Glamis! worthy Cawdor!" to Macbeth, but it is Lady Macbeth's greeting.

books.notes: Source identification: served text = World Library etext exactly (edition_covered 99.92%; the only uncovered tokens are the final "End of this Etext" line, which falls outside the body delimiter). PG #1121 today serves a First Folio text, so the matching text was retrieved from archive.org item 1ws2510 (header "December, 1997 [Etext #1121]"). Root cause: the parser recognised only bare "SCENE N." headings. It skipped "ACT N. SCENE I." headings (losing 1.1, which precedes the first bare heading, and merging each later Scene 1), and never advanced the act counter. MOD_DUP_ADJ flags 12.88/89, 17.41/42, 17.43/44 and DUP_ADJ 15.39-41 are authentic repetitions. The 12.99 merge (Orlando + Rosalind) is verbatim from the source layout. No local raw.
